suggested_title: Elisabeth Abeles - MD Graduate (Class of 2023), General Surgery Resident
prospect_notes: Elisabeth Abeles completed her BS in Arts and Sciences at Cornell University as a Hunter R. Rawlings III Cornell Presidential Research Scholar and member of the Singh Lab (Immunotherapy and Cell Engineering Laboratory) in the Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering. She was accepted to Johns Hopkins School of Medicine in 2019 and earned her MD with the Class of 2023. She conducted immunotherapy and biomedical engineering research as an undergrad and medical student. She is now a General Surgery Resident at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center / Harvard Medical School and also lists UCSF Department of Surgery experience. Her Cornell undergrad and Hopkins MD are confirmed by the Singh Lab Cornell blog post (June 2019) and the Singh Lab Georgia Tech alumni page.

_enrichment.title: MD, General Surgery Resident (Hopkins MD Class of 2023)

suggested_title: Kate Schole - MD/PhD Student, MSTP Biochemistry (Entering Class of 2019)
prospect_notes: Kate Schole attended Cornell University for her undergraduate degree and matriculated into the Johns Hopkins University MD-PhD MSTP program with the entering class of 2019. Her graduate program is Biochemistry, Cellular and Molecular Biology, with advisor M. Anderson. The Hopkins MSTP is one of the top NIH-funded physician-scientist training programs in the nation, providing full tuition and stipend. She is a current MD/PhD student combining medical training with doctoral research in biochemistry. Her Cornell undergrad and Hopkins MD/PhD enrollment are confirmed by the official Johns Hopkins MSTP entering class webpage listing her by name, institution, and program.

_enrichment.title: MD/PhD Student, Biochemistry, Cellular and Molecular Biology (MSTP, Entering Class of 2019)
